description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for Buzz video links within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract validation rule and checks if a given URL is valid by utilizing the BuzzEmbeddedURL DTO.

classes.name: BuzzVideoLinkValidationRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a provided video URL is valid by leveraging the BuzzEmbeddedURL DTO.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input URL by creating a BuzzEmbeddedURL instance and checking its validity.
